title: Cat Ring Twist Privacy Policy
description: How Cat Ring Twist stores data on your device, how ads and ad consent work, issue reports, and how to delete data.
version: Applies to version 1.0.0. We update this page and its date whenever features or the ad setup change.
summary: You play without signing up or logging in, and your game records stay on your device. There are no in-app purchases. The ad service (Unity LevelPlay) processes device information and advertising identifiers needed to deliver ads; on first launch the game asks whether you allow personalized ads and does not start the ad SDK before you choose. An issue report is sent to TeamCP's report server only when you send one yourself from Settings.

How to reset or delete your Android advertising ID

sections.title: 1. Scope and operator
paragraphs: TeamCP develops and operates the Android game “Cat Ring Twist” (냥냥 고리 돌리기, com.teamcp.catringtwist). This policy explains what information the game handles and the choices you have. Contact: teamcp.channel@gmail.com.

The game has no sign-up, login, chat or in-app purchases. It does not ask for or collect your name, email, phone number, precise location (GPS), contacts, microphone, camera, photos or storage. The permissions the app itself uses are internet and network state (ads and issue reports), vibration (effects) and the advertising ID (AD_ID). The Android ad services attribution and topics APIs and the WAKE_LOCK, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and FOREGROUND_SERVICE permissions come from the ad SDK libraries. If you email support, we use your reply address and message only to answer you.

sections.title: 2. Information stored on your device
items: Game records: stars per level, coins, the Cat collection (cats invited and each cat’s nap count), the last level opened, a record of rewarded-ad hints so the same reward is not granted twice, and what is needed to limit how often interstitial ads appear (rounds finished and the time of the last ad)
Settings: music, sound effects, vibration, language and your personalized-ads choice
Unsent issue reports: a report you sent is kept on the device (up to 50) until the server accepts it, then retried
paragraphs: This information is kept only in the app's private Android storage to keep your progress and settings. Game records and settings are never sent to a TeamCP server. There is no cloud save, and Android auto backup is turned off for this app, so it is not included in your Google account backup. The app contains no analytics tools (such as Firebase Analytics) and no automatic crash reporting.

sections.title: 3. Ads and what the ad services process
paragraphs: The game is free and supported by ads. The ad setup is Unity LevelPlay (ad mediation, Unity Technologies) with Unity Ads. It does not include AdMob, Firebase or any payment SDK.

A TeamCP house banner always sits at the bottom of the screen; once you have made your consent choice and an ad is ready, a banner ad is shown in its place. The house banner opens the TeamCP website in your browser only when you tap it. In addition, interstitial ads may appear when you move on to the next level after finishing a round, limited in number and spacing (never in the first five rounds), and rewarded ads (Hint) that play only when you tap the hint button. You can keep playing without watching rewarded ads.
To load and show ads, the ad services may process the following information.
items: Advertising and SDK identifiers such as the advertising ID and app set ID
Device information such as model, operating system, language, screen, network type and carrier
IP address and the approximate region derived from it
Interactions such as ad impressions and clicks, and ad-related error and diagnostic information
Some information about apps installed on the device (for example, whether an app store is installed)
after: The purposes are showing and measuring ads, preventing fraud (ad fraud), and, if you agree, personalized ads. The app tells the ad services that it is not directed at children. TeamCP does not receive individual user information collected by the ad services; we only see aggregated revenue and impression statistics in the dashboards.

sections.title: 4. Your ad choices
items: On first launch every user chooses between “Allow personalized ads” and “Only non-personalized ads”. Until you choose, the ad SDK is not started and no ad requests are sent. If you choose non-personalized ads, you see the same number of ads, but they are not personalized.
You can choose again at any time in Settings > “Review ad consent”.
In Android Settings > Privacy > Ads you can reset or delete your advertising ID. When it is deleted, a string of zeros is sent instead and cannot be used for personalized ads.
You can ask to access, delete or opt out of ad data through the privacy icon in an ad or the procedure in Unity's policy below.
If you turn off the internet connection, no ad requests are made; the game can be played offline.
paragraphs: Your choice is stored only on the device and passed to the ad service (Unity LevelPlay) as a consent signal. Choosing “Only non-personalized ads” also sends a GDPR consent refusal and a do-not-sell (sale/sharing opt-out) signal under certain U.S. state laws.

sections.title: 5. Issue reports
paragraphs: A report is sent only when you write a description in Settings > “Report an issue” and tap send. There are no automatic reports or crash reports. A report contains:
items: The description you write (up to 2,000 characters) and the report type you pick
Attached automatically: app name and version, the name of the screen you reported from, app language, device model name, and a random report number created for each report
after: Reports never include your advertising ID, an account, your game records or your location. Please do not write personal information such as your name or contact details in the description. Reports are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and stored on a report server operated by TeamCP (web hosting: Cafe24, Republic of Korea), and are used only to find and fix problems. The server and the hosting company may process your IP address in connection logs while the request is handled. Reports stored on the server are kept for 90 days from the day they are received and then deleted; if you ask us to delete one sooner, we delete it right away.

sections.title: 6. Third-party services and international processing
paragraphs: Services from Unity LevelPlay/Unity Technologies and Google (Android ad services) are governed by their own policies. Ad information may be processed outside your country; see each provider's policy for recipients, locations and safeguards. Issue reports are stored on a hosting server in the Republic of Korea.

TeamCP does not sell user information. However, data processing in the ad ecosystem may count as a “sale” or “sharing” under some local laws, so please also review the providers' opt-out and rights information below.

sections.title: 7. How to delete data, and retention
items: On the device: uninstall the app, or use Android Settings > Apps > Cat Ring Twist > Storage > Clear data to delete all game data, including settings and unsent reports. Game records are not kept on any TeamCP server.
Reports you sent: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the date you sent it and your device model (and, if possible, part of the text), and we will find and delete it.
Ad information: delete or reset your advertising ID and use the request procedure in Unity's policy. Uninstalling the app alone does not delete information already processed by ad providers.
Help: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the app name and your request. Do not send passwords or ID documents. For data TeamCP does not hold, we will point you to the provider's procedure.
paragraphs: Game data on the device remains until you delete it. Issue reports sent to the server are deleted 90 days after they are received. Ad information is retained according to each provider's policy. Support emails are not kept longer than needed after we have answered.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete data, restrict or object to processing, withdraw consent, opt out of sale/sharing, or complain to a supervisory authority. Because TeamCP does not keep game data on its own servers, most requests are handled through device settings and the ad providers' procedures; requests about issue reports are handled by TeamCP directly. We will tell you which route to use.

sections.title: 9. Children and parents
paragraphs: Cat Ring Twist is a rotation puzzle game in which you turn the rings of a cat tower until their hidden grooves line up, so each floor comes off and the cat climbs down. It is suitable for all ages but contains ads and is not directed at children under 13. The app tells the ad services that it is not directed at children, and it has no age check or parental consent feature.
If you believe information from a child under 13 has been processed, please contact us and we will explain how to delete it.

sections.title: 10. Security and changes to this policy
paragraphs: Game data is kept in the app's private Android storage, which other apps cannot read. Ad and issue-report traffic uses encrypted connections (HTTPS).

If features, SDKs or processing change, we update this policy and its date first and announce important changes on this page. This document is available in eight languages; if you think the translations differ, please contact us. The Korean version prevails.
